description: This file is a Perl script used to generate RedBoot configuration scripts, particularly for embedded system boot configurations involving kernel and root filesystem images.

methods.name: parse_num
methods.description: Parses a numeric value, interpreting hexadecimal if prefixed with 0x, else returns the numeric value.

methods.name: gen_script
methods.description: Generates a RedBoot script file based on specified kernel and root filesystem images, including configuration and load addresses.
